caveat: References are descriptive, not paragraph numbers. Thresholds are as currently notified and live in this file and checklist.py so they can be updated. Verify against the latest Schedule III, CARO and Income-tax Act text before relying on any item.

items.requirement: Balance sheet shows previous-year comparatives
Statement of profit and loss shows previous-year comparatives
Assets and liabilities classified as current or non-current
Rounding and units of presentation stated
Analytical ratios shown with the items in each numerator and denominator, and the reason for any change above 25%
items.ref: Schedule III additional regulatory information; GN 8.9.12 and Annexure B

items.requirement: Every line has a numbered note and the notes agree to the face
Authorised, issued, subscribed and paid-up share capital (number of shares and amount), par value
items.ask: Memorandum of association / latest share capital records and MGT-7

items.requirement: Reconciliation of shares outstanding at the beginning and end of the year
items.ask: Register of members and allotment records

items.requirement: Rights, preferences and restrictions on shares; shares held by holding or subsidiary companies
Shareholders holding more than 5% (number and %)
Shareholding of promoters at the end of the year, and at the beginning so that the % change can be shown
Movement in each reserve and the surplus, with nature and purpose of each reserve
items.ref: Schedule III, reserves and surplus note

items.requirement: Terms of repayment, rate of interest and security for each borrowing
Current maturities of long-term debt shown within other current liabilities
Loans from directors and other related parties: terms and amounts
items.ask: Director's declaration that the funds are not borrowed; loan terms

items.requirement: Period and amount of any default in repayment of principal or interest
Charges or satisfaction of charges not registered with the ROC within the statutory period
Ageing of trade payables from the due date of payment (under 1 year, 1-2, 2-3, over 3 years), MSME, others, disputed MSME and disputed others
items.ask: Supplier-wise bill due dates (invoice date plus credit terms) from Tally bills outstanding; the ageing runs from the due date of payment

items.requirement: Dues to micro and small enterprises: principal, interest, and payments made beyond 45 days
items.ask: Supplier Udyam registrations and payment dates

items.requirement: Nature of other current liabilities (statutory dues, outstanding expenses, advances) and any amounts overdue
items.ref: Schedule III, other current liabilities note

items.requirement: Gross block, accumulated depreciation, impairment, additions and disposals for each class
Title deeds of immovable property not held in the company's name
Depreciation method, rates or useful lives; revaluation, if any
Classification of inventories and mode of valuation
Ageing of trade receivables from the due date of payment (under 6 months, 6 months to 1 year, 1-2, 2-3, over 3 years), undisputed or disputed, good or doubtful
items.ask: Customer-wise bill due dates from Tally bills outstanding, split undisputed or disputed and good or doubtful; the ageing runs from the due date of payment

items.requirement: Receivables due from directors, officers and related parties
Loans and advances to promoters, directors, KMP and related parties, as a share of total
Cash equivalents separate from other bank balances; earmarked balances, lien or margin money
items.ref: Schedule III, cash and bank balances note

items.requirement: Particulars of loans given, investments made and guarantees or security provided, and the purpose for which they will be used
items.ref: Companies Act Sec 186(4); GN Annexure C
items.ask: Loan, investment and guarantee register with the purpose of each

items.requirement: Quoted and unquoted investments, market value, classification current or non-current
Revenue from operations by product or service where material
Other income shown by nature (interest, dividend, net gain)
Employee benefit disclosures: gratuity, leave, provident fund
Finance costs shown as interest expense and other borrowing costs
Items above 1% of revenue or Rs 1,00,000, whichever is higher, disclosed separately
Payment to auditors: audit fee, tax audit, other services, reimbursements
Tax expense (current and deferred) recognised
Basic and diluted earnings per share
items.ask: Number of equity shares and weighted average

items.requirement: Political contributions disclosed in the profit and loss account with the name of the party
items.ref: Companies Act Sec 182(3); GN Annexure C
items.ask: Party-wise list of donations and confirmation whether any went to a political party

items.requirement: Power and fuel, rent, repairs to buildings, repairs to machinery, insurance, rates and taxes, stores and spares and miscellaneous expenses shown separately
CSR amount required, spent and shortfall
Details of benami property held or proceedings initiated
Wilful defaulter status
Transactions with struck-off companies
items.ask: Check parties against the MCA struck-off list

items.requirement: Undisclosed income surrendered or disclosed in tax assessments
Crypto currency or virtual currency transactions
Borrowings secured on current assets: whether the quarterly returns or statements filed with banks agree with the books, and a reconciliation if not
items.ref: Schedule III additional regulatory information; GN 8.9.7
items.ask: Quarterly stock and debtors statements filed with the bank, compared with the books; applies if borrowed on current assets at any point in the year

items.requirement: Compliance with the number of layers of companies (name, CIN and holding of companies beyond the limit)
items.ref: Schedule III additional regulatory information; GN 8.9.11

items.requirement: Scheme of arrangement approved under Sec 230 to 237: accounted for in accordance with the scheme and accounting standards
items.ref: Schedule III additional regulatory information; GN 8.9.13
items.ask: Management declaration and the NCLT order, if any scheme exists

items.requirement: Funds advanced or received through intermediaries (utilisation of borrowed funds and share premium)
Significant accounting policies
Cash flow statement
Related-party disclosures: relationships, transactions and balances (including directors' remuneration)
Leases: operating lease commitments and rent
Deferred tax on timing differences (depreciation, provisions)
Deviations from accounting standards, the reasons and the financial effect
items.ref: Companies Act Sec 129(5); GN Annexure C
items.ask: Management declaration that there are no deviations, or the details

items.requirement: Contingent liabilities and commitments
items.ask: Legal, tax and bank guarantee records

items.requirement: Small company status (affects cash flow statement and other exemptions)
CARO 2020 reporting by the auditor
Auditor's report on internal financial controls
items.ref: Companies Act Sec 143(3)(i); MCA notification of 13/06/2017

items.requirement: Tax audit
items.ref: Income-tax Sec 44AB (renumbered under the Income-tax Act 2025 from FY 2026-27)
